svg.text: Fig. 1. SurgicalVLA at inference: past-only object tokens and latent reasoning in a frozen SmolVLM2 prefix; a phase- and object-conditioned MoE action expert

g.title: instruction ℓ · LIBERO-Spatial episode 1261. The target phrase “black bowl” is read from it and prompts SAM 3.
g.text: and place it on the plate”
the policy is re-run every 50 steps

g.title: SigLIP + pixel-shuffle connector · [2, 3, 512, 512] → [128, 960] · SmolVLM2's vision tower; 32×32 patches pooled 4× by pixel shuffle.
SAM 3 → instance masks · Per frame and without memory, so object inputs never see the future. Cached for training; 236 ms per chunk live.

object projector · 3.2 M · [4, 392] → [4, 960]; context c_obj ∈ ℝ^{720} · pose = box (4), mask centroid (2), median relative depth, SAM 3 score. Also emits the object context c_obj for the MoE router.
explicit CoT text · Teacher-forced during training and faded out by the curriculum; never decoded at inference.
latent queries · Latent reasoning tokens; trained to predict the embedding of the frame 1 s ahead (Fig. 3).
prefix tokens · ≈ 233 × 960 · images | text | objects | state attend bidirectionally; CoT text and latent queries are causal.
SmolVLM2 decoder · first 16 of 32 layers · d = 960 · [≈ 233, 960] → K, V per layer · Its keys and values are cached and reused by all 10 denoising steps.
g.text: SmolVLM2 decoder · first 16 of 32 layers · d = 960
self-attention + SwiGLU · 204.6 M · frozen · run once per action chunk

g.title: noisy · noise at flow time τ
action expert · [50, 720] → [50, 720] · SmolVLA's action expert with every FFN up-cycled to a mixture of experts.
e_phase · At inference no CoT text is fed, so the router's phase input is a learned constant (modeling_smolvla_moe._phase_from_hidden).

svg.text: Example: LIBERO-Spatial episode 1261, frame t = 36. 792 M parameters, 442 M trained; the VLM and the perception models stay frozen. Thick arrows: main data path. Fig. 2 details one expert layer; Fig. 3 the training.
